title: Block reports Q3 revenue up 10% YoY to $6.7B, above est., Cash App gross profit up 27% to $2.07B, raises its full-year profit outlook; XYZ jumps 5%+ after hours (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Block reports Q3 revenue up 10% YoY to $6.7B, above est., Cash App gross profit up 27% to $2.07B, raises its full-year profit outlook; XYZ jumps 5%+ after hours — Jack Dorsey-led Block (XYZ.N) raised its full-year gross profit outlook on Tuesday after posting a rise in third-quarter earnings …
